body_html: @aaronpk @eddiehinkle could something like the indieweb.org wiki be used as an h-card database for the @ mention idea? Like if someone like @martijnvdven and @dshanske whose twitter handle is different than IRC nick had a u-url to Twitter in the h-card could this be scraped from wiki (or other public h-card directory..an #IndieWeb phonebook) and if you published to @gwg or @zegnat on your blog it would be syndiated to Twitter using their handles?
